title: Claude read-only delegations refuse `git rev-list`, which Codex read-only reviewers can run
outcome: Claude read-only delegations refuse `git rev-list`, which Codex read-only reviewers can run
acceptance: A Claude read-only delegation can run `git rev-list` for read-only queries (for example `git rev-list --parents -n1 HEAD` and `git rev-list --count A..B`), with its option checking matching the existing read-only git subcommands: anything that writes a file, starts a pager or viewer, or cannot be checked is refused.
A test covers an allowed rev-list form and a refused rev-list option, and the PowerShell-tool refusal stays unchanged.
